variants.headline: Party leader faces a challenge
variants.body: The leader of {party} is being challenged. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: Leadership becomes a contested question
variants.body: A challenge to the leadership of {party} has opened. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.

variants.headline: A challenge inside the party
variants.body: Leadership of the party {party} is under challenge. The gazette favours fair treatment of {target} rather than an adverse verdict founded upon assumption alone.
